architecture: four-frame Qwen3.6 vision encoder, temporal mean, binary MLP (identical to prod gameplay v8)
initialization: prod gameplay v8 checkpoint, model weights only (fresh optimizer/schedule)
label_policy: window t..t+3 s at 1 Hz is rally when its centre t+1.5 s is within 2 s of a human sparse-v4 event; natural class ratio
selection: Score every epoch on full10 with scripts/score_gameplay_pipeline_inputs.py and select with scripts/evaluate_rally.py: fewest GT events missed at threshold 0.5 with no padding, then most dead time rejected. Held-out validation (12 cuts, 769 events) reports gt_events_missed per epoch but is too small to select on; validation F1 picked a worse epoch.
